body:
I don't seem to see this option in the Edit menu anymore. Was it removed at some point? Or is some particular config required to see/enable it?

I do note it is still listed in the Help content.
The option was moved to other place #3394 (see also, #4280).
Since it's a global option now shall we just remove the button from the resend dialog?
Not if it still works (and if it doesnt then we should fix it) - being able to override a global option from a specific dialog is really useful
The behaviour between the option and the dialogue is still the same (it was already global, the difference is that the option state is now persisted).
Will it be confusing to users if they disable a global setting while sending a single request?
The resend dialog shouldnt change the global setting, that would be confusing. It should just override it for the requests sent from the dialog.
Will look at it again and also see if I can find somewhere we do that overriding.

Ok so looking at HttpPanelSender as @thc202 suggested, it does seem the value is being used correctly:
https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/blob/d61c34a0db69380def911e035f20992ba7ce78f0/src/org/parosproxy/paros/extension/manualrequest/http/impl/HttpPanelSender.java#L214-L215

I guess the state of the button was simply out of sync, for which I believe I have a fix. Overriding `windowOpened` didn't seem to work as expected however using `windowActivated` does.
